the quiet laws of etiquette
graceful women live by

presence

walk slower. sit up straight.
speak a little softer.

at the table

napkin on your lap. wait until
everyone has been served.

in conversation

remember names. ask one more
question. never interrupt.

online

reply kindly, not quickly.
no voice notes to strangers.

as a guest

never arrive empty-handed.
offer to help clear the table.

character

be on time. keep your promises.
return what you borrow.

and trade ten minutes of scrolling
for something worth knowing.
